 Malappuram FC vs Thiruvananthapuram Kombans FC Preview- Team news, lineups | Super League Kerala 2026
 By Niranjan R Prabhu Follow Add as Preferred Source From the stands to the study desk, Niranjan covers Indian football and beyond. Published at : November 21, 2026 at 1:24 PM (GMT+5:30) Modified at : November 21, 2026 at 1:24 PM (GMT+5:30) Malappuram FC have qualified for the Super League Kerala playoffs. 
 Malappuram FC will face Thiruvananthapuram Kombans FC on the 21st of November, 2026 at the Payyanad Stadium, Manjeri, for the second game of the Round 9 fixtures of the Super League Kerala 2026 .
 Malappuram FC and Thiruvananthapuram Kombans FC, who have had a shaky start to the season, rose from their ruins to earn a spot in the top four. Malappuram FC, with 14 points in hand, have qualified for the playoffs, while the Kombans, with 11 points, are so close to securing a berth in the semi-finals.
 As both teams lock horns against each other at Manjeri, a game which will see the comeback of Kervens Belfort and John Kennedy, fans are expected to be in the edge of their seats. Here is a look at the stakes involved for the match. 
 The Stakes
 Malappuram FC 
 During the match played between Malapuram Fc Vs Kannur Warriors FC in the Super League Kerala 2026 Season 3 held at Payyanad Stadium Manjeri on October 26th 2026
Photos : Shibu Preman / S3 Media / Super League Kerala 
 As far as Malappuram FC are concerned, they have already secured a spot in the playoffs and are out of contention for the playoffs. Hence, there is nothing much at stake for the Malabar side as they arrive for this game. 
 Keeping things aside, Malappuram would be eyeing all three points at home; however, with caution, as they have already lost three players for the remainder of the season citing injury. Hence, the team, along with aiming for a win, would also look forward to minimising any chances of injuries as they approach the playoffs.
 Thiruvananthapuram Kombans FC 
 During the match played between Thiruvananthapuram Kombans FC and Malappuram FC in the Super League Kerala 2026 , Season 3 , held at Chandrasekharan Nair Stadium , Thiruvananthapuram on September 11th 2026
Photos : Thangapandi B / Super League Kerala 
 Facing Malappuram FC in this round and later Thrissur Magic FC in the final round, they need three points, meaning a full-time win to secure a spot in the playoffs, no matter how other results turn out. However, if they do not manage to win the next two games, they would have to rely on the results of Thrissur Magic FC and Kannur Warriors FC to determine whether they qualify or not. 
 Hence, Thiruvananthapuram Kombans FC will eye all three points or at least a penalty win at Malappuram, which could further strengthen their possibilities of qualifying for the next round. 
 Team News
 Malappuram FC will miss the services of Bibin Ajayan, Mashoor Shereef and their top scorer Amadou Soukana as they have been ruled out of the season citing injury. 
 Player to Watch Out For
 Malappuram FC – John Kennedy 
 The Super League Kerala 2025 Golden Boot winner, John Kennedy, is the latest addition to the Malappuram FC roster, following the ruling out of Soukana. Kennedy had also made significant contributions in his championship-winning season with Calicut FC in the Super League Kerala 2024. 
 Kennedy’s ability to play centrally as well as from the wings makes him a constant menace for the Kombans’ defenders. Comfortable playing both through the middle and from the left, he offers the kind of flexibility Malappuram now requires for their crucial playoff stage.
 Already familiar with Indian conditions, recently featuring for Gokulam Kerala FC, if Kennedy can perform to his potential, he could very well lead Malappuram FC to their maiden title.
 Thiruvananthapuram Kombans FC – Kervens Belfort 
 The former Kerala Blasters FC striker, who was also the chief architect for Calicut FC in their Super League Kerala 2024 winning campaign, Kervens Belfort joined forced with the Kombans for the remainder of the Super League Kerala 2026 season. 
 Kervens Belfort adds an experienced attacking presence to Thiruvananthapuram Kombans FC, with the Haitian forward bringing a combination of pace, technical ability and an eye for goal.
 Belfort’s versatility in the final third allows him to operate across different attacking positions, offering the team flexibility in how they approach their offensive play. His experience playing in various leagues and competitive environments could also prove valuable as Kombans eye to navigate their way to the playoffs. 
 Predicted Lineup

 Malappuram FC (4-1-2-3) 
 Muhammed Arbaz (GK); Muhammed Salim, Muhammed Bilal, Abdul Hakku Nediyodath, Bibin Anwar; Grace Adieu Youmou; Bongani Zungu, Prabanj Prasad; John Kennedy, D. Lahlhimpuia, Abdelhay Elforsy
 Thiruvananthapuram Kombans FC (4-2-3-1) 
 Satyajit Bordoloi (GK); Shinu R, Shane Sajan Jacob, Abhiram K, Ariston Costa; Patrick Mota, Joseph Gordon; Arjun V, Kiatalua Norberto, Sreeraj K; Kervens Belfort
 When and where to watch the Super League Kerala 2026 match between Malappuram FC and Kannur Warriors FC?
 The Super League Kerala 2026 match between Malappuram FC and Thiruvananthapuram Kombans FC will take place on 21st November 2026 at the Payyanad Stadium, Manjeri.
 Fans all across India can watch the Super League Kerala 2026 matches digitally on Zee5, alongside linear coverage on Unite8 Sports. Fans from the UAE can enjoy the Super League Kerala action with Etisalat.
